prompt: The checkout page crashes when I click the Pay button
referenceResponse: Acknowledges the bug report and indicates a ticket or follow-up will happen

prompt: How long do I have to return an item?
referenceResponse: States that items can be returned within 30 days of delivery, based on the FAQ

modelResponses.response: You have 30 days from the date of delivery to return most items, as long as they are unused and in their original packaging, unless the item arrived defective. For more details, please refer to FAQ entry 11.

prompt: I want to speak to a manager about a billing dispute from last year.
referenceResponse: Politely redirects the customer to call the support phone number

modelResponses.response: Hello! It sounds like you have a specific issue that our support team can assist with. Please call us at 1-800-555-0199, and a member of our team will be happy to help you with your billing dispute. Thank you!
